text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 53 Plunkett Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated November 23, 2018, regarding the property located at 53 Plunkett Road for Items 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12 and 13 only. 2. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated November 23, 2018, regarding the property located at 53 Plunkett Road, and in doing so granted an extension of time for Items 1, 5, 8 and 10 only to April 30, 2019.
